data.name: Charlie
data.message: Just finished chart course, heading to security for cameras. Want to buddy up?

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Hey Alice, doing cameras. Want to stick together after?

data.name: Alice
data.message: Sure, I'm heading to weapons quickly then we can buddy up. Follow me?

data.name: Eve
data.message: Just doing a quick scan, you can witness it

data.name: Bob
data.message: Heading to electrical then security, want to buddy up?

I found Diana's body in electrical. My route was storage → medbay → electrical. I saw Eve in medbay at ticks 8 and 9 — she was there when I passed through. When I got to electrical, Diana was already dead. So whoever killed her was in electrical just before me, or came through cafeteria. I need to hear where everyone else was — especially Alice, Charlie, and Frank.

Bob's right that I was in medbay at ticks 8 and 9 — he walked through and can confirm that. My full route was security → weapons → cafeteria → medbay → electrical → medbay. I actually was in electrical earlier this round, and I saw Diana there at tick 6 — she was alive then. I came back through medbay after. Bob then passed through medbay heading to electrical at tick 9, and that's when he must have found her.

So the kill window is somewhere between tick 6 and when Bob arrived. I didn't see anyone else come through medbay besides Diana leaving toward electrical at tick 5 and Bob heading that way at tick 9. That means the killer likely came into electrical from cafeteria side, not through medbay — otherwise I'd have seen them. Alice, Charlie, Frank — where were you all? Anyone in cafeteria or near electrical needs to account for themselves.

I started in navigation working on my task. Frank was with me there at tick 4 — he came in from security. I then moved to security myself, arriving around tick 6, and Alice was already in security when I got there. I've been in security since then doing my CheckCameras task, with Alice present the whole time.

So Alice and I can vouch for each other from tick 6 onward, and Frank was in navigation/security area at tick 4. That means none of us three were in electrical during the kill window Eve described.

If Eve's story checks out — that she was in medbay at ticks 8-9 and Bob confirms that — then the suspect pool narrows. But I want to flag something: Eve says she was in electrical at tick 6 with Diana alive, then went back through medbay. That puts her closest in time to the kill. Bob only confirms her medbay presence at 8-9, not what happened between 6 and 8.

Frank, we need to hear your route after navigation. And Eve — can anyone besides Bob confirm you in medbay continuously? I'm leaning suspicious of Eve right now, but want to hear Frank before deciding.

My route was weapons → security → navigation → storage. I saw Eve in weapons at tick 1 — she came in from security. Then I moved through security to navigation, where Charlie was working on his task at tick 4. I left navigation heading to storage after that, and I've been in storage since.

So Charlie's right that we were together in navigation around tick 4. I can confirm he was doing his task there before heading to security.

Now here's what's interesting about Eve's story: she claims her route was security → weapons → cafeteria → medbay → electrical → medbay. I saw her in weapons at tick 1 coming from security — that matches. But that means she went weapons → cafeteria → medbay → electrical, putting her in electrical around tick 5-6, which she admits. Then she says she went back through medbay.

The problem is Bob only confirms her in medbay at ticks 8 and 9. There's a gap between tick 6 (electrical with Diana alive) and tick 8 (medbay) where she's unaccounted for. That's exactly the kill window. She could have killed Diana in electrical and then walked back to medbay to establish an alibi with Bob.

Charlie and Alice vouch for each other in security. Charlie and I overlap in navigation. Bob's route is consistent. Eve has the opportunity and is closest to the crime scene in the critical window.

I'm voting Eve.

I can confirm Charlie's account — I was in security when he arrived from navigation at tick 6, and we've been together since. My route was electrical → security → weapons, then back to security. Importantly, I was in electrical early this round — before tick 6 — and Diana was not there when I was. So electrical was empty-ish before Eve's claimed tick 6 visit.

That actually matters: if I was in electrical before tick 6 and didn't see Diana, and Eve says Diana was alive in electrical at tick 6, then Diana arrived in electrical around the time Eve was there. Eve then claims she left back through medbay — but Frank is right, there's a gap between tick 6 and tick 8 where Eve is unaccounted for. That's the kill window, and Eve was the last person confirmed with Diana alive.

Charlie and I alibi each other. Frank and Charlie overlap in navigation. Bob's route through storage → medbay → electrical is consistent and he found the body. Eve is the only one with both opportunity and proximity.

I'm voting Eve.

Wait, I already spoke first — but let me add one clarification since you're all asking about Eve. 

To confirm what I said: I saw Eve in medbay at tick 8 AND tick 9. She was there both ticks I passed through. That's continuous as far as I can tell — she didn't just pop in for a second to establish an alibi right before I arrived. If she killed Diana in electrical at tick 6-7, she would have had to immediately go back to medbay and just sit there waiting, which is possible but means the kill happened fast.

That said, Frank and Alice make a strong point — Eve was the last person confirmed with Diana alive, and the gap between tick 6 (electrical) and tick 8 (medbay) is exactly the kill window. Charlie and Alice alibi each other in security. Frank overlaps with Charlie in navigation. My route is storage → medbay → electrical, and I found the body.

Eve has the opportunity and proximity. I'm voting Eve too.

Hold on — everyone's piling on the "gap" between tick 6 and tick 8, but let's think about what that gap actually is. It's TWO ticks. The travel time from electrical back to medbay is part of that. I was in electrical at tick 6, saw Diana alive, and moved back to medbay — that's tick 7 transit, tick 8 in medbay where Bob saw me. That's not a suspicious gap, that's literally just walking.

For me to have killed Diana, I would have had to kill her at tick 6 in electrical, then immediately leave — but Diana was ALIVE when I left. If I'd killed her at tick 6, Bob would have found the body much earlier, and Diana wouldn't have had time to move around.

Here's what's actually suspicious to me: Alice says she was in electrical "before tick 6" and Diana wasn't there. Fine. But Alice's route is electrical → security → weapons → back to security. That's a lot of movement, and she places herself in electrical right before the kill window. Who's to say Alice didn't double back? Charlie says Alice was "already in security" at tick 6 — but did Charlie actually see Alice arrive, or was she just there when he walked in? Because if Alice came from electrical and Charlie didn't witness the arrival time, her alibi from 6 onward is real but her pre-6 movements aren't verified.

Also — Frank, you say you were in storage "since" leaving navigation. Nobody saw you in storage. Bob passed through storage on his route — Bob, did you see Frank in storage?

I'm not the killer. I'd look at Frank or Alice more carefully before locking in on me.

Eve, I hear your pushback, but let me address it directly.

First, on Alice: I can actually confirm she was in security continuously from tick 6 onward. I didn't just "find" her there — I arrived at tick 6 and she's been with me the entire time through this meeting. So whatever she did before tick 6, she physically could not have been in electrical during the kill window. Your deflection onto her doesn't hold.

Second, on Frank: Bob, can you confirm whether you saw Frank in storage when you passed through? That's a fair question and worth answering. But even if Frank wasn't visible, his route weapons → security → navigation → storage is corroborated by me seeing him in navigation at tick 4, and by you seeing him in weapons at tick 1. His movement timeline is consistent.

Third, on your "two tick gap" defense — you're framing it as just travel time, but here's the thing: you placed yourself in electrical with Diana at tick 6, alone with her. You're the last person to see her alive by your own admission. Even if the gap is "just walking," you had the opportunity and the proximity, and nobody else fits that window. Bob came from storage → medbay → electrical and found the body. Alice was locked in security with me. Frank was in navigation then storage. That leaves you.

I'm voting Eve.

I've already spoken once, but to reinforce: my analysis stands. Eve placed herself alone with Diana in electrical at tick 6 by her own admission — she's the last person confirmed with Diana alive. Charlie and Alice alibi each other in security from tick 6 on. Charlie and I overlap in navigation at tick 4. Bob's route is consistent and he found the body.

Eve's deflection onto Alice doesn't work because Charlie confirms Alice was in security continuously from tick 6 — she physically couldn't be in electrical during the kill window. And her deflection onto me is weak: my route is corroborated by Eve herself seeing me transit (she saw me in weapons context), by Charlie in navigation, and storage is a dead-end task room — of course nobody saw me there, that's where I was doing my task alone.

Eve, the "two-tick gap is just walking" defense actually hurts you. You admit you were alone with Diana in electrical at tick 6. Whether you killed her at tick 6 and left, or the kill happened in that transit window, you're the only person with both opportunity and proximity. Everyone else has overlapping alibis.

I'm sticking with my vote: Eve.

I've already spoken and laid out my analysis, but since I have the last word, let me make it clear and decisive.

Eve placed herself alone with Diana in electrical at tick 6 by her own admission. That's the critical fact. Everyone else has overlapping alibis:
- Charlie and I confirm each other in security from tick 6 onward — continuously, through this meeting.
- Frank and Charlie overlap in navigation at tick 4.
- Bob's route storage → medbay → electrical is consistent, and he found the body.
- Eve is the only one with both opportunity and proximity in the kill window.

Her deflection onto me doesn't work — Charlie witnessed me in security from tick 6 on, so my pre-6 movements are irrelevant to the kill window. Her deflection onto Frank is weak too; storage is a task room and his timeline is corroborated by multiple players.

The "two-tick gap is just walking" defense is actually an admission — she was alone with Diana, then alone in transit, then conveniently in medbay when Bob arrived. That's textbook duck behavior: establish an alibi witness right after the kill.

I'm voting Eve. Everyone else should too.
